summary: Iteration 2 frontend regression on redesigned dashboard @ 980x1100. All 10 targeted checks executed via Playwright + curl. Team logo fallback verified (7/7 match rows and hero banner all have img OR .team-logo-fallback). Footer (socials, telegram, legal tabs, suppliers) fully functional; legal-tab-tumu=14 paragraphs, legal-tab-kvkk=3 paragraphs. Sponsors panel has no empty slot and sponsor-adidas renders; POST /api/sponsors/click returns 200. BoxOffice gross '₺88.764.304.726' has no ellipsis and no client overflow; boxoffice-plot removed from center card and ozet-plot present in right panel. Filters TR/FR work (HAZIRLIK returns only 2 friendly badges, no LaLiga leak). Channel select and ozet-toggle work. Match detail navigation from match-row-0 works and back link returns to home. One minor gap: match-detail page does not expose data-testid='md2-hero' (other md2-* neon markup still rendered based on visible layout; match-back-link, match-home, match-away, match-score all present).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='md2-hero' not present on the hero panel; test spec explicitly checks for it. Other md2-* elements likely render correctly but the automation hook is missing.

action_items: Add data-testid="md2-hero" to the hero wrapper in app/match/[id]/page.tsx (or MatchDetailClient) so redesign hero panel is testable. All other md2-* checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Console has a non-blocking Next.js smooth-scroll warning: add data-scroll-behavior="smooth" to <html> per Next.js 15+ guidance.
Sponsors click endpoint schema uses 'sponsor_id' — frontend sendBeacon must send that exact key (verified working via curl).
test_credentials: Not required for these public flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport locked to 980x1100. Live scores load in ~6-8s — always sleep 8s post-navigation. Match detail hero missing md2-hero testid (only cosmetic gap). Everything else in iteration_2 review request verified green.
rca of the issue: md2-hero missing: likely the hero <section> in match detail page was styled with md2-* classes but the automation testid attribute was not added when redesign classes were introduced. Fix: add data-testid="md2-hero" to the wrapper element enclosing match-home/match-score/match-away in app/match/[id]/page.tsx (or the client component if hero is client-rendered).
